gameDescriptionHtml:
Barton Lynch Pro Surfing pits you against the world’s top surfers in some of the world’s most exotic locations. As you freely explore 12 legendary surfing beaches, ride the waves with unique controls, a range of weather conditions, and comprehensive customization tools.

Barton Lynch Pro Surfing is a true to life sports game that pits you against the world’s best surfers at the most exotic locations on the planet. The expansive world tour features an in-depth leaderboard and sports commentary, or if you prefer to free surf, simply cruise around the vast beaches at your leisure.

Cutting edge graphics meets hardcore physics and beautifully brutal waves. Pump control uses the wave’s power so you can surf faster and unlock more moves. More speed = more moves! Pump, smash that lip, get sooo barreled and launch airs from waves that barrel, peak, break left and right, or just foam crumble.

Customize your own character to your liking or play as some of today’s top pros, including: Yago Dora, Clay Marzo, Nathan Florence, Soli Bailey, Mahina Maeda, Vahine Fierro, Felicity Palmateer, and of course the legendary world champion, coach and Pro Surfing commentator Barton Lynch.

Game Features

  • A massive career mode: set out to conquer the world rankings in a singles career or via online ghost leaderboards. Manage your money, equipment, health and performance to reach the top. The tour is a sporting challenge like no other, so be sure to leave it all out there in the waves.
  • Many game modes: tour modes, free surf, trick challenges – barton lynch pro surfing features endless hours of challenge and replayability. Featuring a set of progressive difficulties at each location helps you to build your skills and knowledge of the waves so you can take your real-time skills and start ripping it up in real life.
  • World champs & underground heavyweights: see how you compare to the big names on the tour, like yago or soli, or underground chargers like nathan and clay. Or what about taking on big wave chargers vahine, mahina or felicity? Barton lynch pro surfing features a wide range of surfers to test your mettle against.
  • Customizable characters: customize your entire look down to the finest detail. Your choice of equipment impacts what happens in the game, with a variety of wetsuits, rashies, fins, board shorts, and board shapes including sizes, widths, bottom, tails, rails, noses – every item will have an effect on your performance out there on the waves.
  • Real life iconic locations: each location is based on an iconic surfing destination designed to take you wherever you want to be. From snapper, mundaka, to pipeline or the box – we’ve got you covered.
  • Customizable surfing conditions – made for you, by you: use the sick weather tool to directly impact how you play in real-time. Big, sunny, low tide and glassy? You got it! Messy and small with a heavy cross-shore wind so you can practice your boosts? Yeah!
  • Legit soundtrack: smoking martha, kilns, oly sherman, wing defence, mesmeriser and bad pony headline the distinctive soundtrack that blends well with barton lynch pro surfing’s worldwide vibe and fluid physics-based control mechanics.
